title: Remove env-file CLI Flag + Simplify Startup Env Resolution
description: Remove the --env-file pre-scan flag and the CWD .env fallback from Program.cs startup. The only way to configure an env-file is via 'zapi-cli config set env-file <path>'. If no env-file is configured, no .env file is loaded at startup (silent). The error for missing ZOHO_CLIENT_ID is thrown at login time (story-21), not at startup.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1–21 complete. Program.cs has ExtractEnvFilePath pre-scan, resolvedEnvFile logic that falls back to CWD .env, and a --env-file flag. Story-21 defers env-var validation to login time.
goal: After this story: Program.cs startup env resolution is: read CliSettingsStore.TryReadPersistedEnvFile(earlyConfigDir); if non-null, LoadDotEnv(persistedEnvFile); done. No --env-file flag. No CWD fallback. Silent if unconfigured.
scope: Modify src/ZapiCli/Program.cs — remove the ExtractEnvFilePath method entirely. Remove all code that pre-scans args for '--env-file'. Remove the '?? Path.Combine(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory(), ".env")' CWD fallback. New env resolution: var persistedEnvFile = CliSettingsStore.TryReadPersistedEnvFile(earlyConfigDir); if (persistedEnvFile != null) LoadDotEnv(persistedEnvFile); — no else branch, no fallback, no CLI flag.
Verify that GlobalSettings.cs and all command settings classes have no --env-file option defined. If any exist, remove them.

Verify that templates/ contains no account-login.json references to env-file or client credentials. If templates/account-login.json exists and is no longer relevant after story-21 deleted LoginConfig, delete it or update its content to be consistent with the new login surface (no file-based login config).

Update docs/HELP.md — remove any mention of --env-file as a CLI flag. Update the 'Configuration' or 'Authentication Overview' section to state: env-file is configured once via 'zapi-cli config set env-file <path>' and auto-loaded at every subsequent invocation. There is no per-invocation override.

Unit tests: (1) When no env-file is configured (TryReadPersistedEnvFile returns null), LoadDotEnv is NOT called — verify no side effects from missing file. (2) When env-file is configured, it is loaded at startup. (3) Verify --env-file is no longer a recognised flag (Spectre will return INVALID_ARGS if it is passed).
acceptanceCriteria: No --env-file CLI flag exists anywhere in command settings
No CWD .env fallback in startup resolution
Startup env resolution is: read persisted path, load if non-null, done
templates/account-login.json is deleted or updated to remove credential fields
HELP.md updated to remove --env-file flag reference
contextForAgent: The ExtractEnvFilePath pre-scan method rebuilds the args array without the --env-file flag before Spectre parses it. Removing it is safe because the flag no longer exists as a Spectre option after this story. Double check that no existing test calls ExtractEnvFilePath — remove any such test. The LoadDotEnv helper in Program.cs is kept intact (used during normal startup). Only the resolution logic changes.
